descriptor.name: NCSCM CZMP — Puducherry survey plots (overlaps resolved)
descriptor.scope: Survey-plot outlines on the Puducherry Coastal Zone Management Plan. Coverage follows mapped coastal planning areas and can omit city centres and inland neighbourhoods. Labels are descriptive; application references are derived from each outline and change when the outline changes.
descriptor.attribution: National Centre for Sustainable Coastal Management (MoEFCC) — CZMP survey plots, Puducherry. Plot labels shown as published; references derived from geometry. Adapted to WGS84.
caveats: Coastal-zone planning maps, not the land-records register: plot outlines are a geometry reference, not proof of current title or ownership.
Survey labels can be repeated, blank or zero. They are shown as published, never used as identity; OBJECTID is a transport field.

Some outlines overlap (neighbouring village maps were drawn and georeferenced separately). Each overlap is given to the larger outline (equal areas: the lower reference); the smaller parcel shows the rest as derived ground. References still come from the published outline or key.

Application identity uses the source namespace plus canonical geometry SHA-256 at 1e-7-degree precision and a spatial locator. A changed outline gets a new reference; absence means that outline version was not returned.
The service answers browsers directly (CORS allows this site); no relay is used.
The service does not state the plan version or the survey date of the underlying plot maps.
